issue: Operating profit should match sales minus expenses within 1%
description: Operating profit should match sales minus expenses within 1%
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM profitandloss WHERE sales IS NOT NULL AND expenses IS NOT NULL AND operating_profit IS NOT NULL AND ABS((sales-expenses)-operating_profit) > MAX(1, ABS(sales)*0.01)
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM profitandloss WHERE sales <= 0

issue: Net cash flow should equal operating + investing + financing within 1 crore
description: Net cash flow should equal operating + investing + financing within 1 crore
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM cashflow WHERE net_cash_flow IS NOT NULL AND ABS((operating_activity+investing_activity+financing_activity)-net_cash_flow) > 1

issue: Available annual report URLs should be HTTP(S) PDF links
description: Available annual report URLs should be HTTP(S) PDF links
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM documents WHERE annual_report IS NOT NULL AND (annual_report NOT LIKE 'http%' OR lower(annual_report) NOT LIKE '%.pdf%')

issue: Dividend payout should be between 0 and 200
description: Dividend payout should be between 0 and 200
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM profitandloss WHERE dividend_payout < 0 OR dividend_payout > 200

issue: EPS sign should generally match net profit sign
description: EPS sign should generally match net profit sign
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM profitandloss WHERE eps IS NOT NULL AND net_profit IS NOT NULL AND ((eps < 0 AND net_profit > 0) OR (eps > 0 AND net_profit < 0))

issue: Companies should have at least five years across P&L, balance sheet, or cash flow
description: Companies should have at least five years across P&L, balance sheet, or cash flow
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM companies c WHERE (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT fiscal_year) FROM profitandloss p WHERE p.company_id=c.id) < 5 AND (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT fiscal_year) FROM balancesheet b WHERE b.company_id=c.id) < 5 AND (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT fiscal_year) FROM cashflow cf WHERE cf.company_id=c.id) < 5
